sections.title: What is new
sections.content: You know degree adverbs from C1 Unit 19 (*számottevően*, *drasztikusan*), the adverb in *-ul/-ül* from A1 Unit 32, the superlative from A2 Unit 16 and *-va/-ve* from B1 Unit 29. Here they judge conduct: *szakmailag feddhetetlenül* ('in a professionally irreproachable way'), *erkölcsileg mélységesen aggályos* ('morally deeply questionable'), *a legszigorúbb mércével mérve* ('measured by the strictest standard'). What is new in this lesson is the vocabulary of integrity and these three phrases.

sections.title: Example
sections.content: Example: *A riporter szakmailag feddhetetlenül dolgozott.* *Szakmailag* and *erkölcsileg* say from which point of view you judge; the degree adverb (*mélységesen*, *feddhetetlenül*) says how far.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A riporter szakmailag feddhetetlenül, a fenyegetések ellenére is közölte a tényeket.
The reporter professionally irreproachably published the facts despite threats.
A propaganda kiszolgálása erkölcsileg mélységesen aggályos.
Serving propaganda is morally deeply questionable.
A legszigorúbb erkölcsi mércével mérve az írástudók felelősek a szavak tisztaságáért.
Measured by the strictest moral standard intellectuals are responsible for the purity of words.
